name: Ninkyou Hana Otome
source:
One day, Ryota is at a loss what to do in front of an old house. "What...?" After two and a half hours from Tokyo, he arrives at a small town. His mother passed away a while ago and he came to the town following her will. He now stands in front of the house his mother indicated. However, anyone can tell that it's a gang's house.... 

[From ErogeShop]
